owners_ruling_as_received: Keep the flagged model table. When neither output is trustworthy (model flagged AND native ungridded), keep the model version, carry the flag visibly on the page, and do NOT fail the page. Rationale: the model version is usually the correct one, and a visible flag on a good table beats deleting a table to punish uncertainty.

hole_A.status: DISSOLVED BY THE RULING — surfaced, not gated
hole_A.what_it_was: _apply_structural_gate only inspects an ACCEPTING inner decision, so a candidate that is both structurally defective and an ambiguous deferral is never gate-inspected.
hole_A.what_I_did: Did NOT add the structural gate at the keep site (the round-2 instruction, explicitly withdrawn). The same predicate runs there via manifest.kept_table_grid_defect for SURFACING only: the defect is named in the page body and in the flagged_model_table_kept event's detail and data.grid_defect. The gate itself is untouched.

hole_B.agreement_with_the_leads_interpretation: AGREE, and I would have argued for it independently. The ruling's rationale is explicitly about uncertainty. A drift record is not uncertainty: the value guard positively identified that the model wrote 9.99 where the page reads 6.60. 'Carry the flag visibly' is unsatisfiable if the finding reaches no surface, and today it reached none. Keeping the table while saying nothing is the cardinal rule violated by the fix meant to honour it.
hole_B.one_qualification_I_would_add: The owner's measurement ('the model version is usually the correct one') was made on STRUCTURE — the reference page's 26 paired-header rows versus 19 flat ones, with all 112 decimals present in both lanes. It is not evidence about VALUES. So the ruling straightforwardly justifies keeping a structurally-disputed table; it justifies keeping a value-disputed one only on the weaker ground that the alternative (native) is also distrusted on that page. That is why the value case gets a louder surface than the structural one — named cells in the body, in the CLI, and its own distrust kind — rather than the same treatment. If the owner disagrees and wants a value-drift page failed rather than flagged, that is a one-line change to the pages_ok term and I would not argue.
changes: src/socr/tables/native_verifier.py: NEW field VerifierResult.unadjudicated_drift, populated when _value_guard detects a multiset mismatch that a row-count discrepancy downgrades from CERTAIN_FAIL. Deliberately NOT folded into drifted_rows, which means 'the drift that caused the hard fail' and which crop_repair.py:99 keys on for label_binding_failure.
src/socr/tables/native_verifier.py: describe_drift(), one renderer shared by every surface so the wording cannot diverge.
src/socr/pipeline/agentic.py: emits table_value_drift_unadjudicated once per assess, before the tri-state dispatch so it fires on warn, row-count-warn-only and accept alike.

src/socr/core/tables_trust.py: kind added to TABLE_DISTRUST_KINDS (a detection, alongside native_table_verifier_hard_fail) — this is what puts the page in tables_trust.json and in the metadata 'untrusted tables' note.
src/socr/core/manifest.py: kept_table_flag_note() puts a greppable marker in the shipped body naming the disputed values; kept_table_grid_defect() for hole A's surfacing.

src/socr/pipeline/orchestrator.py: value_drift_pages bucket derived from the audit log (the judge has no PageState to mark — the doc_fabrication pattern), its own pages_ok term, and a CLI block that names the values rather than counting pages.
hole_B.page_is_not_failed: Confirmed by test: winner.status is WARNING, no failure marker in the body, document is AUDIT_FAILED (the 'completed with warnings, output written' path), content ships.

asymmetry_flagged_for_the_reviewer: The SAME ragged text now goes two ways depending on who refused it: inner judge ACCEPTED -> the structural gate rejects -> no soft mark -> native; inner judge REFUSED -> ambiguous deferral -> kept and flagged. This is a faithful consequence of the allowlist plus the ruling (the gate path is a deterministic verdict on an otherwise-shippable candidate and was explicitly left alone; the soft path is what the ruling governs), and both directions are tested. Named here because it is surprising, not because I think it is wrong.

non_vacuity.vacuity_bugs_I_caught_and_fixed_this_rou: First drafts of test_drift_names_the_disagreeing_values and test_ragged_kept_grid_is_flagged_not_handed_back_to_native failed at baseline with `ImportError: cannot import name 'describe_drift'` and `'kept_table_grid_defect'`. Both now reach the new symbols by attribute with a fallback; the ragged fixture's setup assert uses table_output_defect, which exists at baseline, so it can never be what fails there.
non_vacuity.round2_head_9b95d37: the five round-3 tests fail there; test_a_clean_kept_table_carries_no_noise passes
